summary: United Microelectronics Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing two routine corporate items: (1) registration of a capital reduction due to cancellation of restricted shares (RSA), reducing paid-in capital from NT$125,785,246,190 to NT$125,769,848,700 and shares outstanding from 12,578,524,619 to 12,576,984,870, with book value per share essentially unchanged from NT$32.33 to NT$32.34; (2) a repurchase update noting cumulative repurchases exceeding NT$300 million in value, with 6,500,000 shares repurchased at an average price of NT$98.12, representing 0.13% of issued shares. Neither item constitutes a special situation; the capital reduction is a routine equity adjustment and the repurchase is an ongoing buyback disclosure.
